notes.title: Achivements update!
notes.content:
Dear HGDC Players,

🏆 Achievements Are Now Available!
You can now compete with other players by completing various challenges and tasks to unlock unique achievements. Collect all the achievements and prove yourself as a true HGDC master!

🐛 Bug Fixes 
Our team has diligently worked on resolving several pesky bugs that may have hindered your enjoyment of the game. The game now runs even more smoothly, and we hope you appreciate the improvements.

🌍 New Languages WIP: Ukrainian and German
We are also pleased to announce that we are actively working on translating the game into Ukrainian and German languages. This will allow even more players to enjoy HGDC in their native tongues. Stay tuned for updates!

Thank you for being with us! We hope these changes will make your HGDC experience even more thrilling. Keep an eye out for news and updates, and don't forget to share your feedback with us. Happy gaming!

notes.title: Exciting News! FREE Adult DLC is awaiting moderation.
notes.content:
🌟 Coming soon to Steam, a long-awaited adult patch! We've been listening to your feedback and are now working on expanding the gaming experience for our more mature audience. Dive into the storyline and interact with the characters in a whole new light.

📚 But that's not all! We are also actively developing a visual novel "Juicy Like Me" that will transport you to a captivating world of a TV show where mystical creatures adapt to life among humans. This unique adventure will be available in two versions: a standard one on Steam and an extended adult version(We plan to make it available exclusively on Patreon). Expect incredible twists and intriguing stories!

Patreon: patreon.com/JuicyLikeMe

We are also working on a Discord server.
Stay tuned for our updates, join our community, and keep up with all the happenings in the world of SSASSY. We have a lot of excitement ahead, and we can't wait to share it with you!
